newsitem.title: UK: Scottish TV survey places Conservatives fourth.
newsitem.headline: Scottish TV survey places Conservatives fourth.

text.p: Britain's ruling Conservatives are trailing behind Labour, Scottish Nationalists and Liberal Democrats with only 13 percent support in Scotland, according to opinion poll results broadcast on Monday.

Three days before parliamentary elections, a telephone poll for Scottish Television (STV) and Grampian Television put Labour in the lead with 37 percent, down five points since a survey early in April.
The Scottish National Party (SNP), which wants an independent Scotland, gained one at 30 percent.
The Liberal Democrats were up six points at 19 percent and the Conservatives down one at 13 percent. Five hundred people selected at random across Scotland took part in the poll.
